summary: DOES NOT MEET (class WRONG: gate G5 fails on L3.3.3.1). The package is complete and the enclosure shell is good: L1.2, L1.4-L1.11 all pass on my own STL measurements (USB plug d=0.400, jack plugs d=0.401, lip gap 0.25 all round, walls/floor/lid 2.40, no unlisted openings, 83.97 x 63.17 x 24.70). Failures concentrate in L1.1, L1.3 and L1.12 and trace mostly to stale catalogue data: parts/perfboard/part.json has hole_inset 2.5 / hole_diameter 3.0 / grid origin at the hole (requirements A7: 2.0 / Ø2.0 / grid X 5.79+2.54i, Y 3.41+2.54j), giving standoffs on a 65 x 45 pitch 0.707 off the board holes, and the catalogue has only an M2.5 self-tapper so standoff pilots are Ø2.10 instead of M2's 1.6-1.8. Independently, the Pico is placed flush to the -X board edge (USB_MOUTH X -1.30, need 2.62-3.62; header grid residual 4.51) and the cavity is only 1.1 mm wider than the board on -Y/+Y/+X, so walls cut 0.4 mm into the Ø7 screw-head columns (L3.3.5.1). Weighted score 119/137 = 0.869; worst normalised weight-3 margin -3.0 (L3.3.1.3 and L3.3.3.1). Coordinates are board frame (origin = perfboard top-surface corner at min X/min Y, Z=0 board top); the delivered STLs are already in this frame with USB at -X (no transform). Enclosure-frame Z = board Z + 8.1 (floor underside at board Z -8.1).
